summary: Westrock Coffee Company filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 6 to its credit agreement, extending the maturity of ~$361M in loans/commitments from August 2027 to November 2028, while ~$26M continue to mature in 2027. The amendment also modifies restricted payment covenants (secured net leverage ≤3.75x, liquidity ≥$25M) and adds Texas Capital Bank as a lender. This is a routine refinancing/credit amendment and does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or going-private transaction.
